parameters.query:
=-- Bank the win when the reply was "done". The scoreboard in the weekly
-- digest reads from money.wins, so this is what makes the number climb.
WITH target AS (
  SELECT id, title, annual_value_gbp, source
  FROM money.actions
  WHERE id = {{ $json.action_id }}
),
banked AS (
  INSERT INTO money.wins (action_id, description, one_off_gbp, annual_gbp)
  SELECT
      t.id,
      t.title,
      -- Claims tend to pay a lump sum; leaks save money every year.
      CASE WHEN t.source = 'claims' THEN t.annual_value_gbp ELSE 0 END,
      CASE WHEN t.source = 'claims' THEN 0 ELSE t.annual_value_gbp END
  FROM target t
  WHERE '{{ $json.verb }}' = 'done'
  RETURNING one_off_gbp, annual_gbp
)
UPDATE money.actions
SET status      = '{{ $json.verb }}',
    resolved_at = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.verb }}' = 'open' THEN NULL ELSE now() END
WHERE id = {{ $json.action_id }}
RETURNING title, annual_value_gbp,
          (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(one_off_gbp + annual_gbp), 0) FROM money.wins) AS banked_total;
